facts.value: We have never been afraid of challenging the established. The established way of thinking, of doing things. We spot opportunities when they arise, and we have the people, experience, and tools to make the most of them. In OKEA, we have a flat structure that enables efficient processes. Leaders and management are open and available to our colleagues. That means, if we want something done, our streamlined organisation will enable us to reach our goals. This also goes for our partners and suppliers. Our One Team philosophy, embedded across our organisation, ensures we collaborate effectively to manage our projects successfully. Our strategy is to further develop mid- and late-life assets. By tying new resources to existing infrastructure, utilising new technologies and increasing efficiency, we reduce cost and our operational footprint while extending the life-time of our assets. We may strive to make things more efficient and straightforward, but we never, ever compromise on HSEQ as safety is fundamental to our licence to operate. Open We dare to share info openly. We meet each other with understanding and positivity. We are always being honest. We dare to be proud. We drive clarity

explanation.text:
OKEA ASA (org.nr 915 419 062) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 2015-04-29, registered 2015-05-20. [brreg_enheter] Main industry (NACE 06.200): Utvinning av naturgass; also Utvinning av råolje. [brreg_enheter] Registered purpose: "Petroleums-virksomhet på norsk sokkel, inkludert utbygging og utvinning av olje og gass, og hva dermed står i forbindelse, samt ved aksjetegning eller på annen måte å delta i slik eller annen virksomhet alene eller i samarbeid med andre foretagender og interesser." [brreg_enheter] The company's website describes it as: "We’re OKEA – a leading operator of mid- and late-life assets on the Norwegian continental shelf. We extend field life, explore for new resources, and unlock value from existing infrastructure." [website] Wikipedia: "OKEA ASA er et norsk oljeselskap grunnlagt i 2015 med fokus på utbygginger og produksjon på norsk kontinentalsokkel. Selskapets største eiere er det thailandske petroleum- og energikonglomeratet Bangchak Corporation, samt det bermudiske holdingselskapet Okea Holdings Ltd. Hovedkontoret ligger i Tron" [wikipedia] Business address: Kongens gate 8, 7011 TRONDHEIM. [brreg_enheter] Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Svein Jakob Liknes; board chair Chaiwat Kovavisarach; 10 other board members. [brreg_roller]

Key numbers:
- Registered employees: 542 (as of 2026-08-10); 53 registered sub-units. [brreg_enheter]
- Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue USD 808,101,000 (-93% vs 2024); operating result USD -34,537,000 (-101% vs 2024); net result USD -54,669,000 (-114% vs 2024); total assets USD 1,815,617,000 (-91% vs 2024); equity USD 57,199,000 (-95% vs 2024). [brreg_regnskap]
- Accounts on file for 2023, 2024, 2025.
- Share capital: NOK 10,391,035. [brreg_enheter]
- LEI: 549300H385IGBB58CN91 (ACTIVE). [gleif]
